title: Seal of Quality
introduction: The Seal of Quality certifies that a specific version of a resource has been reviewed by SNEStorage staff and meets SNEStorage's minimum quality standards. The seal applies to that reviewed version; it does not automatically apply to other versions.

sections.title: How to request a review
sections.description: The Seal of Quality is optional and is requested for a specific version.

rules.title: An optional review, requested per version
rules.text: Requesting the Seal of Quality is optional. Enable the "Request the Seal of Quality" checkbox for the version you want SNEStorage staff to review. A request is not an award: the seal is granted only after the version has been reviewed and approved.

sections.title: What you gain
sections.description: Recognition for a reviewed release, with a visible distinction throughout the resource library.

rules.title: A quality standard users can recognize
rules.text: Other users can see that a version of your resource has been reviewed by SNEStorage staff and meets our minimum quality standards.

rules.title: A highlighted listing and a dedicated filter
rules.text: Your resource is highlighted in the resource list. Users can also filter the library to find only resources with a Seal of Quality.

rules.title: The seal beside your resource's name
rules.text: The Seal of Quality logo appears beside the name of your resource.

rules.title: A golden resource name
rules.text: Your resource's name is displayed in gold.

sections.title: What you commit to
sections.description: Reviewing a release takes additional staff effort. Resources awarded the seal must respect these commitments.

rules.title: Do not delete a resource with a sealed version
rules.text: A resource with at least one version awarded the Seal of Quality cannot be deleted through normal resource management. Exceptional deletion must be discussed with SNEStorage staff as described below.

rules.title: Do not delete sealed versions
rules.text: Versions awarded the Seal of Quality cannot be deleted.

rules.title: Get staff permission before editing
rules.text: Do not edit a resource that has a sealed version, or a version awarded the Seal of Quality, without permission from SNEStorage staff.

rules.title: Keep the resource public
rules.text: A resource with a version awarded the Seal of Quality must remain public.

rules.title: Contact staff if deletion is genuinely necessary
rules.text: If the authors have a genuine problem that requires deleting the resource, they must contact a SNEStorage staff member to arrange its deletion. This exception cannot be demanded if any resource author, the resource submitter, or anyone who submitted one of its versions is banned.

sections.title: Can the seal be removed?
sections.description: The account standing of everyone associated with the resource matters.

rules.title: Only if no associated authors or submitters are banned
rules.text: You may request that the resource stop carrying the Seal of Quality only if none of its authors, its original submitter, or the submitters of any of its versions are banned.

sections.title: What staff review
sections.description: The reviewed version must meet all of the following requirements.

rules.title: Compliance with all SNEStorage rules
rules.text: The resource and the reviewed version must comply with all SNEStorage site rules.

rules.title: The resource works as intended
rules.text: Code must do what it is expected to do. Graphics must use their specified formats, music must work correctly, and other resources must function properly for their stated purpose.

rules.title: Complete and accurate resource information
rules.text: The resource form must be correctly filled out, including accurate classifications, specific dependencies, all authors, and the other information relevant to the resource.

rules.title: Adequate README documentation
rules.text: Include appropriate README documentation that clearly explains how to use the resource.

rules.title: A minimum artistic quality
rules.text: Graphics, music, sound effects, and other artistic resources must meet a minimum level of quality, as assessed by SNEStorage staff.

rules.title: Good previews when required
rules.text: Provide good-quality previews when they are required to demonstrate the resource.
